*'''Gallery:''' [[Commons:Featured pictures/Places/Architecture/Bridges#China]] or [[Commons:Featured pictures/Places/Architecture/Cityscapes#China]] *{{Info}} created by [[User:dllu|dllu]] – uploaded by [[User:dllu|dllu]] – nominated by [[User:Dllu|Dllu]] -- [[user:dllu|dllu]] [[User_talk:dllu|(talk)]] 22:11, 26 July 2026 (UTC) *{{Info}} I found it amazing that this giant bridge was towering over the already rather tall apartment buildings. The whole sea-crossing channel, comprising two bridges (the two-pylon Gaolangang Bridge on the left and the three-pylon Huangmaohai Bridge on the right) connected with viaducts, has a total length of 31 km, and was completed in 2025. This view was taken from the rooftop of an apartment building in Pingsha (I happen to know someone living in the penthouse there). We were fortunate that the air quality was good enough to see the link fairly clearly despite being tens of kilometers away.
